notes.content:
We at ThoseBros Entertainment are giving away 100 dollars to the first person who beats the game with 0 deaths. We also name the achievement for 0 deaths after you. In order to be eligible you must has all death related achievements, the secret code for beating the game with 0 deaths, a screenshot of your scores screen, and may require proof of completion. This is subject to final approval and the terms may be changed at anytime. Only 1 person will win.

*Not applicable to ThoseBros devs or affiliates
